name: LFM2.5-24B-A2B

lineage.how_derived: post-training of the base: SFT, teacher specialization, two multi-domain on-policy distillation stages (non-agentic, agentic) and agentic RL inside agent harnesses; architecture kept from LFM2-24B-A2B, context 32K to 131K and vocabulary 65K to 128K

purpose: Built for fast, private agents on-device: a reasoning model that calls tools and runs reliably locally. The builder states it is not recommended for knowledge-heavy tasks on its own and should be paired with retrieval or web search.

architecture.kind: hybrid gated short-convolution + GQA attention MoE
architecture.attention: 10 GQA layers (32 Q / 8 KV heads) and 30 gated short-convolution layers; the first 2 layers have dense FFN (num_dense_layers 2)
architecture.drafter: separate DSpark drafter (327.7M parameters, 5 attention layers, block size 9)
architecture.why_this_design: Sparse activation (24B total, 2B active) for speed on constrained hardware; reasoning-only so the high decode speed pays for the chain of thought; the convolution + GQA hybrid is kept from LFM2-24B-A2B (blog). The card gives no deeper reasons.

variants.notes: also Q4_0 13.58, Q5_K_M 17.03, Q6_K 19.69, Q8_0 25.49, BF16 47.96, and QAD (quantization-aware distilled) Q4_0 13.58 and Q2_K_L 9.54; the card says QAD-Q4_0 is the one that makes up for 4-bit loss
draft model for speculative decoding (SGLang); on a B300 with the FP8 target 2.4x output throughput at concurrency 1, 1.7x at 256 (vendor)

pc-12gb.notes: 14.5 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM budget; 2.45 B active, experts stream from RAM; QAD-Q2_K_L (9.5 GB) nearly fits VRAM, quality unmeasured

pc-16gb.notes: 14.5 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM budget, remainder from RAM

pc-24gb.notes: Q6_K 19.7 GB or Q8_0 25.5 GB with a few experts in RAM

mac-16-24gb.notes: 13.6 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB; a user reports Q4 under 16 GB at about 120 tok/s on an M5 Pro (HF discussion), vendor 184 tok/s decode on an M5 Max

mac-32gb.notes: one independent test ran it on an M1 Pro 32 GB: about 52 tok/s generation at Q4_K_M

engine_support.notes: Official GGUF; independent test used llama.cpp b10964. Tona needs an lfm2moe backend (short convolution layers plus MoE); DSpark drafter is documented for SGLang only.

benchmarks.name: AA-Omniscience
benchmarks.unit: index (negative: hallucinates more than it answers right)

benchmarks.name: 75 multi-step tool tasks (7-16 dependent calls), pass rate
benchmarks.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M, llama.cpp b10964, card sampler

strengths: Fast decode for its quality tier (2.45 B active)
Correct tool-call syntax: no call needed recovering from text in the independent test
weaknesses: Independent multi-step agent test: 49 % against 91 % for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B at Q4_K_M, wrong actions followed by a 'done' summary in 23 of 38 failures
Knowledge: negative AA-Omniscience, builder says to pair with retrieval
Tool calling in OpenCode reported as poor by one user at Q4 and Q8
soft.behavior: Pure reasoning model, template inserts the think tag; Pythonic tool calls by default (JSON on request). Recommended sampling temperature 0.1, top_k 50, repetition penalty 1.05. Uses about twice the tokens of Qwen3.6 per solved task in the independent test.
best_for: fast local tool-calling and instruction-following assistants on 16 to 32 GB machines
avoid_for: long multi-step agent tasks (independent evidence weak)

user_reports.summary: Pre-registered independent test: tool-call parsing fine, 49.3 % against 90.7 % on 75 multi-step tasks, about 52 tok/s on an M1 Pro; vendor replied it will take the feedback into account
M5 Pro, llama.cpp: Q4 under 16 GB at about 120 tok/s, Q8 about 24 GB at about 80 tok/s; tool calling and OpenCode use were not good

soft.maturity: Liquid AI ships a dense family (230M to 24B) with GGUF, MLX, ONNX and DSpark drafters at release; the vendor answers in HF discussions; the card calls this the largest and final LFM2.5 model, LFM3 follows.

tona_fit.reason: Fast and small, but the only independent agent evidence is weak (49 % against 91 % for a comparable-size Qwen) and the builder itself excludes knowledge and coding use. Re-check after a Q8 or QAD independent run.
